touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Llangybi qualifies as a local detour through Cross-Incised Stone in Llangybi Churchyard and Church of St Cybi. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Llangybi: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
